name: 42. ภูเก็ต เขต 3 (บช).pdf
summary:
This document, titled "ประกาศคณะกรรมการการเลือกตั้งประจำเขตเลือกตั้งที่ ๓ จังหวัดภูเก็ต เรื่อง ผลการนับคะแนนสมาชิกสภาผู้แทนราษฎรแบบบัญชีรายชื่อ" (Announcement of the Election Commission for Constituency 3, Phuket Province, on the Results of the Party-list Member of the House of Representatives Vote Count), announces the vote count results for the party-list election. The election date was February 8, B.E. 2569 (2026).


Summary of Election Statistics:
Voter Eligibility and Turnout:
Total eligible voters: 117,627 people.
Voters who presented themselves: 82,182 people.
Ballots:
Ballots allocated to the constituency: 117,036 ballots.
Ballots used: 82,182 ballots.
Remaining ballots: 34,854 ballots.
Ballots Used for Counting (Total: 82,182 ballots):
Ballots in polling stations: 77,983 ballots.
Advance voting ballots within the constituency: Information missing or combined.
Advance voting ballots outside the constituency and the Kingdom: 4,199 ballots.
Vote Count Results (Total Score: 76,649):
Valid ballots (บัตรดี): 76,649 ballots.
Invalid ballots (บัตรเสีย): 2,319 ballots.
"No Vote" ballots (บัตรไม่เลือกผู้สมัครใด): 3,214 ballots.
Top 3 Highest Scoring Political Parties (Party-List):
ประชาชน (Prachachon) (Number 46): 25,483 votes.
ประชาธิปัตย์ (Democrat) (Number 27): 23,777 votes.
ภูมิใจไทย (Bhumjaithai) (Number 37): 11,138 votes.
The announcement was made on February 8, B.E. 25649 (2026) and signed by the Chairman and two members of the Constituency Election Commission.
